title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: Working with Translations and Languages
summary: Blog series covering translations, multilingual development, and language features in Dynamics 365 Business Central, including XLIFF files, language pack installation, field captions, localization support, and translation tools.
key_points: XLIFF translation files are used for working with translations in Business Central
Language packs can be installed for both SaaS and on-premises deployments
Developers can manipulate field captions, enum values, and translated content via AL code
Language and region settings can be configured at company and environment levels
Translation tools including Dynamics 365 Translation Service and Custom Translator are available for partners
features: Language and region settings for reports
